marketing_wrapper: 01 and 02 are 100% marketing (sky photo, script wordmark, laurels, press logos; no UI). 03-06 are ~65-75% UI inside a black iPhone frame on a sky-blue to periwinkle gradient backdrop, with a 2-3 line white caption band on top; 03 is tilted with floating content tiles behind it.

typography.display: Light-to-regular geometric sans for screen titles ('Daily Practice', 'Sleep' in a light weight); semibold for content titles ('Bilateral Stimulation for Nervous System Reset'). Looks custom or a licensed geometric face, not SF. The script 'Calm' wordmark appears only on marketing and the curator avatar.
typography.body: custom geometric sans (unsure of name; not SF: round 'a', geometric 'o')
typography.weights: light for section headers, regular body, semibold for card titles and buttons
typography.case_and_tracking: sentence/title case, normal tracking; marketing uses tracked caps for 'FEATURED IN' and 'WINNER' only

palette.accent_strategy: No chromatic accent. A deep blue/indigo scene background, white text, and a white-lavender pill for the primary Play action. Colour comes from per-content photo and illustration tiles.
palette.source: palette.json 03 (#185d91 phone screen, 22%), 05 (#2c5288, #32467d), 03 #162238 dark gradient bottom; Play pill read visually. #59b9f5/#55aceb are the marketing backdrop.

shape.radius_language: large, ~16-20pt on artwork tiles; pill chips (outlined) and pill buttons
shape.borders_shadows: 1pt light outlines on unselected filter chips and the secondary Shuffle pill; no shadows; thin hairline divider between shelves
shape.materials: translucent circular back and overflow buttons over hero art (05/06); otherwise flat over a blue gradient

liquid_glass_visible: unclear: the circular back and '...' buttons on the 06 hero are translucent tinted circles, consistent with glass or a plain blur
density: low; one large hero card or 2-up tiles per viewport, generous 20-24pt gutters, horizontal shelves with 'See All'
layout: Streaming-catalog home: screen title, filter chip row, then horizontal shelves of large artwork tiles (Featured, Soundscapes, Soothing Music); 2-column grid for Daily Practice; detail page = full-bleed art top half, title, curator row, Play/Shuffle pills, description.
navigation: No tab bar visible in any frame. Top: large left-aligned screen title, filter chips as segment control. Detail: floating circular back and overflow buttons over the hero image.
imagery_and_icons: Celebrity and presenter photos with gradient tint, painterly/anime-style illustrated scenes for music, nature photos for soundscapes, abstract 3D render for the nervous-system track. Minimal outline icons (heart, play triangle, shuffle).
signature_visual_move: Everything sits on one deep sky-to-indigo gradient, so the night-sky blue is the brand and the content art is the only other colour.
tells_present: Gradient backgrounds and gradient text (marketing backdrop and in-app blue-to-indigo screen gradient)

direction_fit.primary: NEW: Dark Content Stage (tinted variant) - streaming-catalog shelves on one night-blue stage where content art carries the colour
direction_fit.secondary: Authored Illustration (weak: illustration appears only as content tiles, not as a governing hand)
direction_fit.why: The text record suggested Sensory-First plus Authored Illustration (BUCK) and a possible Glow-Dark Wellness exemplar. The screenshots show no single illustrator's hand and no glow; they show a Spotify-like shelf catalog of celebrity and photo tiles on a blue gradient. Sensory-First cannot be judged from stills.

notes: Two of six frames are pure trust marketing (laurels, press logos), which itself signals a funnel-heavy store posture. The in-app UI could be any premium audio catalog with a blue skin. Glow-Dark Wellness is not supported by these frames.
